population_boundary: All durable complete, OpenAP-supported and successfully first-pass-modelled flights before the four release quality gates on 2026-03-01.

external_source.name: OpenSky Complete One Day Trino Tables Snapshot (March 2026)
external_source.source_relation: Different aggregation and distribution chain from adsb.lol; overlap among underlying community receivers is possible and is not observable in this snapshot.

source_flight_anchor.time_preference: takeoffLandingInfo takeoffTime/landingTime; fall back as a pair to firstSeen/lastSeen
source_flight_anchor.coordinate_preference: takeoffLandingInfo coordinates; fall back independently at each endpoint to the first/last valid point in track
source_flight_anchor.invalid_if: times are absent or non-increasing, or either endpoint lacks finite valid latitude/longitude

matching.runner_up_rule: on both primary and source sides, accept a non-singleton candidate set only when best_score <= 0.75 * second_best_score

state_vector_extraction.deduplication: for each icao24 and lastPosUpdate retain the row with the latest snapshot time

temporal_aggregation.method: after exact-position-time deduplication, take the median of point time, coordinates, reported velocity, altitude and vertical rate inside each Unix-minute bin; onGround is the majority value
temporal_aggregation.purpose: make one state-vector observation per physical minute and prevent a sub-second coordinate contaminant from defining segment speed or flown distance

source_quality.coverage_definition: after registered one-minute aggregation, one minus the sum of entire consecutive gaps longer than 120 seconds divided by first-to-last point duration
required: strictly increasing point time after deduplication
at least ten positive model steps no longer than 600 seconds

proxy_model.typecode_source: primary durable table, joined only after matching and source-quality classification
proxy_model.observed_fuel: OpenAP with source ground speed; no IAS is available in the snapshot
proxy_model.wind: the same immutable ERA5 grid and baseline code as the release
reported_components: total, lateral and vertical ratio-of-sums gaps

estimands.primary: For this one day and for source-quality-pass matches, difference in the OpenSky proxy total-gap percentage between flights that passed and failed the primary release gate.
secondary: matching and source-quality response rates by frozen primary failure mask
same pass-minus-reject contrast for lateral and vertical proxy gaps
comparison of OpenSky proxy and frozen primary decomposition on primary-gate controls
estimands.missing_outcomes: No correction or imputation; report nonresponse by failure mask and treat the outcome contrast as conditional on external match and source quality.
estimands.inference: post-pilot exploratory day-census diagnostic; no confirmatory p-value or interval, no sampling confidence interval and no extrapolation to the 197-day release

post_pilot_amendment.trigger: The frozen raw consecutive-position speed guard left only 172 model outcomes because sub-second OpenSky state snapshots contain sporadic coordinate contaminants while reported velocity remains physically coherent.
post_pilot_amendment.diagnostic_observation: Raw maximum segment speed was <=1200 kt for 180/8726 matched tracks; median aggregation in 60-second Unix bins was <=1200 kt for 8532/8726. Sensitivity was inspected at 10, 20, 30 and 60 seconds before this amendment.
post_pilot_amendment.change: Insert the declared robust one-minute aggregation before all source-quality metrics and proxy modelling; keep every matching rule and every other quality threshold unchanged.
post_pilot_amendment.confirmatory_status: This amendment was chosen after inspecting source-quality behaviour. Reanalysis is exploratory and may motivate a future independently frozen day or source; it cannot inherit the original preregistration label.

decision_rule.reason: A single-day, partly receiver-overlapping source can reveal or refute a large conditional selection gradient, but cannot bound the full-release bias or upstream ingestion exclusions.

privacy: Per-flight matching, source identifiers and extracted state vectors remain outside git; only aggregate diagnostics and hashes may be committed.
